title: Declassified Upshot-Knothole report puts Stansel at the Nevada tests
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Declassified Upshot-Knothole report puts Stansel at the Nevada tests, about 1953 at Nevada test site and Area 51, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And a declassified report from Operation Upshot Knol confirms Stansel was on site for the nuclear testing there.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, in an episode asking whether Henry Kissinger oversaw a secret program to recover crashed UFOs, talks about a man named Arthur Stansel. Michels says a declassified report from Operation Upshot-Knothole, a series of US nuclear bomb tests in Nevada in 1953, confirms that Stansel was on site for the testing. He raises it as proof that Stansel really was where his story places him.
